proof_requests: Clear close-up of the console model label/serial sticker (and confirm disc slot if applicable).
Photo/video showing FIFA disc (or game case) included and working in the console.
Video test: HDMI boot to home screen + USB port test.
Controller test video (buttons/sticks) and close-up of controller label/serial.
Photo of the UK receipt and matching serial number on the console.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PS5-like console and controller, but key value drivers (exact PS5 variant, FIFA disc/accessories, receipt/serial proof, and port/controller functionality) are not verifiable from the provided images. To avoid overpaying, request the decisive proof items first.
